name: mook-functions
description: Firebase Cloud Functions for Mook App

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test test/admobRewardedSsv.test.js test/roomSwitch.test.js test/rewards.test.js test/tierPolicy.test.js test/messageQuota.test.js test/deletionSchema.test.js test/likedMe.test.js test/discoverPriority.test.js test/profilePrivacy.test.js test/abuseFlags.test.js test/planCatalog.test.js
scripts.test: npm run build && firebase --config ../firebase.json emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project walktalk-1123f "npm run test:emulator"
scripts.test:rules: firebase --config ../firebase.json emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-walkmatch-rules "node --test test/firestore.rules.test.js test/firestore.security.test.js"
